articles.title: Leeds Beat Chelsea 4-1 at Stamford Bridge
articles.summary: Noah Okafor scored twice as Leeds United secured a dominant 4-1 victory away against Chelsea. This result marks Leeds' first win at Stamford Bridge since 1999 and lifts them up to sixth place in the Premier League table.

articles.title: Arsenal Draw with Newcastle to Extend Lead
articles.summary: Noni Madueke scored a crucial second-half goal to help Arsenal secure a 2-2 draw against Newcastle United at St James' Park. Despite dropping two points, the reigning champions extended their lead at the top of the Premier League table to six points.

articles.title: Teenager Williams-Barnett Shines as Spurs Win
articles.summary: Tottenham Hotspur teenager Luca Williams-Barnett delivered a standout performance for Roberto de Zerbi's side as they comfortably defeated Ipswich Town in their latest fixture.

articles.title: Late Own Goal Hands Coventry Win Over Palace
articles.summary: A late Dwight McNeil own goal in the 85th minute handed Coventry City a 3-2 victory over Crystal Palace. The result moves Coventry three points clear of the relegation zone while ruining Thomas Frank's first match in charge of Palace.

articles.title: Manchester City Held to Draw by Fulham
articles.summary: Elliot Anderson scored a fantastic volley to help Manchester City come from behind and secure a point against Fulham. The draw halts a losing run for City, earning them their first Premier League point in over a month.

articles.title: Evanilson Scores Again as Bournemouth Win
articles.summary: Evanilson found the back of the net for the sixth consecutive Premier League match, helping Bournemouth claim a 2-0 victory against Nottingham Forest at the Vitality Stadium.

articles.title: Aston Villa Held to Goalless Draw by Sunderland
articles.summary: Aston Villa's ongoing struggles at home continued as they were held to a frustrating goalless draw by Sunderland in their latest Premier League encounter.

articles.title: Xabi Alonso Faces Pressure After Chelsea Defeat
articles.summary: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso admits his side must toughen up following a humiliating 4-1 defeat at home to Leeds. The loss leaves Chelsea in eighth place and brings an abrupt end to the positive early atmosphere surrounding his tenure.

articles.title: Bournemouth Make History With Ninth Successive Win
articles.summary: Bournemouth achieved a club record ninth successive win under new manager Marco Rose, defeating Nottingham Forest 2-0 with goals from Evanilson and Justin Kluivert to climb to fourth place in the standings.

articles.title: Newcastle Fight Back to Draw with Arsenal
articles.summary: Arsenal were held to a 2-2 draw by Newcastle United at St James' Park after Matthias Jaissle's side mounted an impressive second-half comeback. The match also saw Arsenal goalkeeper Raya pick up an injury during the tense encounter.

articles.title: Evanilson and Kluivert Lead Bournemouth Past Forest
articles.summary: Bournemouth secured a club-record ninth straight win in all competitions with a 2-0 victory over Nottingham Forest. Evanilson opened the scoring in the 19th minute, marking his sixth consecutive Premier League game with a goal, before Justin Kluivert sealed the three points.

articles.title: Coventry Defeat Crystal Palace in Five-Goal Thriller
articles.summary: Thomas Frank suffered defeat in his opening match as Crystal Palace manager as Coventry City edged a 3-2 thriller. Despite Palace twice equalizing, late defensive errors kept them rooted to the bottom of the Premier League table after five straight losses.

articles.title: Celtic Secure Comfortable Victory Over St Mirren
articles.summary: Goals from Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain, Luke McCowan, and Camilo Duran helped Celtic comfortably defeat St Mirren 4-1. The Scottish Premiership champions overcame injuries to key midfielders to strengthen their position at the top of the table.

articles.title: PSG's Desire Doue Suffers Nasty Knee Injury
articles.summary: Paris Saint-Germain midfielder Desire Doue was carried off the pitch in tears with a suspected serious knee injury during a 3-2 victory against Nice. The youngster twisted his leg awkwardly shortly after scoring his side's second goal.

articles.title: Lawyer Alex Spiro Joining Tom Brady in Chelsea Bid
articles.summary: Lawyer Alex Spiro is reportedly joining former NFL star Tom Brady in discussions to purchase a minority stake in Chelsea. The investors are looking to acquire shares through the club's majority owners, Clearlake Capital.

articles.title: Manchester City Held by Fulham After Anderson Volley
articles.summary: Manchester City ended a three-game losing streak but were held to a frustrating draw by Fulham following a superb volley from Elliot Anderson. The result leaves the home side facing criticism from fans as they navigate a difficult period.

articles.title: Keating Inspires Liverpool to Hold Chelsea to Draw
articles.summary: Goalkeeper Khiara Keating delivered a stellar performance to deny Women's Super League leaders Chelsea, helping Liverpool secure a hard-fought scoreless draw and frustrate Gareth Taylor's depleted squad.

articles.title: Middlesbrough Go Top with Win Over Bristol City
articles.summary: Middlesbrough claimed a 2-0 victory against Bristol City thanks to goals from Adilson Malanda and David Strelec. The win lifts Kim Hellberg's side to the top of the Championship table.

articles.title: Newcastle Halt Arsenal's Winning Run in Four-Goal Draw
articles.summary: Arsenal's four-game winning streak in the Premier League came to an end after Newcastle United fought back to secure a dramatic 2-2 draw at St James' Park.

articles.title: Mario Frick Begins Aberdeen Reign with Six-Goal Win
articles.summary: Mario Frick enjoyed a winning start as Aberdeen manager, guiding his new team to an exciting 4-2 victory over Kilmarnock in a match featuring six goals.

articles.title: Ireland Hold Off South Africa for Narrow Victory
articles.summary: Robert Baloucoune scored two crucial tries as Ireland secured a hard-fought 20-17 victory against South Africa in the Nations Championship.

articles.title: Hearts Thrash 10-Man Dundee in Eight-Goal Rout
articles.summary: Hearts returned to winning form in spectacular fashion, thrashing 10-man Dundee 8-0 in a dominant away performance at Dens Park.
